label: Whatever no ESSENCE_6 condition excludes is possible for an actual root
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: essence-grounded modality for root profiles. For every actual concrete root r at w and every set q of determinations, if q satisfies every ESSENCE_6 condition on r's profile (every condition C such that it lies in the nature of some being that r's profile satisfies C), then at some world accessible from w r really has every member of q. Whatever no nature excludes is possible for the root, so a necessary profile fact needs an essential condition excluding its contrary. It is the profile counterpart of the essentialist account of possibility (EssentialExclusionAccount) and an instance of the Finean 'necessitarian actualist' view that essences are the source of necessity (navigation only). Powers-based accounts (possibility needs a power), Humean recombination and modal primitivism deny it in different ways.
